issues.description: AC-schema's spec wording ('this migration should contain no ALTER TABLE statements whatsoever, only the one CREATE TABLE') does not account for drizzle-kit's standard pattern of emitting an ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT for a new table's own FK -- every migration in this repo (0000-0005) does this for any FK-bearing new table. The migration's actual property (zero existing tables' columns altered) holds; only the spec's literal statement-type wording is unsatisfiable by drizzle-kit's own known output shape for any table with a foreign key. Recommend TEST-DESIGNER tighten the wording on a future spec revision (e.g. 'no ALTER TABLE targeting any table other than the new one').
